assets.prompt: Top-down orthographic terrain art of a PLANET SURFACE, portrait framing, the entire frame is the ground plane seen straight down. Terrain: cracked desaturated teal basalt plain with wind-eroded flat rock shelves, fine gravel, shallow dry channels, a few small impact craters, subtle weathered hexagonal survey etching, thin frost-white mineral veins, scattered angular boulders casting hard cel-shaded shadows. Completely EMPTY flat open ground in the middle third of the frame, no landmark there. Cel-shaded anime style: flat two-tone shading, hard-edged shadows, bold dark outlines on all terrain edges, NO gradients, NO glow. Very dark low-contrast ground so small glowing units read clearly on top later. ABSOLUTELY NO road, NO path, NO track, NO lane, NO trail, NO glowing line, NO energy strip, NO markings of any kind on the ground, NO buildings, NO structures, NO towers, NO gates, NO portals, NO characters, NO vehicles, NO text, NO UI, NO icons. Pure empty planet terrain only, a clean ground texture plate.
